description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.name: Screams from Within
uses.cardState: attached to another creature you control
